overrides._why: src/fonts.css is generated by scripts/fetch-fonts.py and its whole claim is that every declaration is Google's own. font-family-name-quotes unquotes single-word families, and value-keyword-case then lowercases what is left: 'Fantasy' becomes fantasy and 'Inherit' becomes inherit, which stop naming fonts. Both are real Google families. Off for this file only, so Google's quoting survives verbatim and the hazard is impossible rather than enumerated. Every other rule still applies. See the script's docstring.
